items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: he used to play with me

ctx.x: Well, I'm gonna try to get in touch with him, you see, because he used to play with me and he used to get all that job and work around. I'd like to talk to him sometime. All around Bourbon Street, that was our wait quarters. All around that we used to play.
Go back to Buddy Berkman. You said he was a waiter.
He's a waiter and he used to play piano too. He played the piano.
